name: UK England & Wales
dataProvenance: Inheritance Tax Act 1984, Administration of Estates Act 1925, Inheritance (Provision for Family and Dependants) Act 1975
description: IHT thresholds, intestacy rules, IFPA 1975 eligibility, temporal legislation tracking for England & Wales.

conformanceRules.description: IHT nil-rate band must be specified for English estates
At least one executor must be appointed
Testator must have a date of birth for age-based calculations

keyFeatures: IHT nil-rate band, residence nil-rate band, probate registry integration, deed of variation, intestacyHierarchy (9 AEA 1925 s.46 tiers), statutoryLegacy (£322k SI 2023/877), marriageRevocation (Wills Act 1837 s.18)
